title: Semantic Versioning 2.0.0 validation and precedence
prompt: Implement a header-only function `std::optional<int> compare_semver(std::string_view a, std::string_view b)` in the global namespace that implements Semantic Versioning 2.0.0 precedence (https://semver.org).
Return -1, 0 or 1 when a has lower, equal or higher precedence than b. Return std::nullopt if either string is not a valid SemVer 2.0.0 version.
- `MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH` are non-negative integers without leading zeros.
- An optional pre-release follows a '-': one or more dot-separated, non-empty identifiers of [0-9A-Za-z-]. Numeric identifiers must not have leading zeros.
- Optional build metadata follows a '+': one or more dot-separated, non-empty identifiers of [0-9A-Za-z-]; leading zeros are allowed. Build metadata is ignored for precedence.
- No leading 'v', no whitespace, nothing else.

Precedence: compare MAJOR, MINOR, PATCH numerically; a version with a pre-release has lower precedence than the same version without one; pre-release identifiers are compared left to right: numeric identifiers numerically, alphanumeric identifiers in ASCII order, numeric identifiers always lower than alphanumeric ones, and a shorter list of identifiers is lower if all preceding identifiers are equal.
Numeric components may be arbitrarily large (larger than 64 bits) and must still compare correctly.
